text.description_html:
Baldwin Single Cylinder Deadbolt Extension Kit for 2-1/4" Thick Door, Baldwin 8098.000.TP03

This extension kit allows single cylinder deadbolts to be used on doors 2" - 2-1/4" thick. For use with Baldwin Estates Tubular Deadbolts.

Kit includes extra long tail piece and screws. Screws are not visible and are not finished.

*Sold Individually
